text: Write the 97 letters in rows of 7 and read the columns down. Every known letter is carried to a new place, and the carved letter there is its enciphered form. Drawn for one route; the E at place 22 lands at place 4.

With the table and a repeating secret word, each landed pair forces one key letter. Thirteen neighbours end up 14 apart, so at a period of 28 they share key slots in pairs, and the forced letters must agree.

The experiment ran 2,905 routes under all 24 ways of using the table. No route lets a secret word shorter than 23 letters explain the known letters, and no puzzle word fits the forced letters of any route.
